description: Default window capabilities for MacroVox dictation + settings windows. Required-permission rationale: shell:allow-open backs Stripe checkout + billing portal links (URLs are hostname-allowlisted on the call sites per SECURITY_AUDIT_2026-04-16 § H9). process:allow-restart backs the auto-updater's post-install relaunch via tauri-plugin-updater. updater:default backs the same updater flow's version-check + download. clipboard-manager:allow-write-text writes transcripts to the system clipboard. Everything else is window-chrome control for the custom-decorations HUD.
